title: Define owner-facing typing signal method in JMAP Chat
description: The main spec (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00) promises typing indicators as a feature but only defines the receive side. There is no owner-facing method for a client to signal typing state to their own server. The chain is broken: client-to-server leg is missing entirely. Peer/typing (server-to-server) is defined in the federation spec, and the SSE/WebSocket delivery to clients is defined, but the originating client has no specified way to tell its server it is typing. Need to define a method (e.g. Chat/typing) and add it to the main spec.
